raw_requests: Unchanged evals.json, fixtures, trigger queries and prior native input-prompt bytes. Original grades remain immutable.
scope: One candidate regression iteration, no controlled baseline-improvement claim.
common_delivery: Required authorized artifacts actually saved, read back and externally hashed; no invented output paths or self-digest.
Artifact envelopes truthful: actual producer devforge-brainstorm, idea-ledger/handoff types only, installed identity, source attribution, missing facts disclosed.

Causal/execution/prior artifact references use sections, project/authority alias and root-relative paths resolving exact ID/revision/SHA-256. Missing stable source IDs disclosed, never invented. Absolute paths/mount maps separate.
Standardized input/output, observed-verification, continuation tables in successful, blocked and routed handoffs with real owner, prerequisites, completion evidence and copyable immediate task.
No required template placeholders or fabricated PASS/adoption. Named behavior, required delivery/reference shape and overall case separately graded.
Handoff creation records only already observed checks; later readback/publication remains NOT_RUN and receipt path planned. No future receipt or final delivery preclaim.

Actual external JSON receipt files resolve completed task artifacts with matching SHA-256; handoff itself excludes its digest and receipt future state. Allowed Outcome cells exactly PASS, FAIL, NOT_RUN, COULD_NOT_RUN, NOT_APPLICABLE.

B_named_behaviors.B1: An idea ledger at docs/devforge/ideas/ with attributed ideas, open questions carrying consequences, decision_ref null, plus a handoff. No invented users or market claims. No stack chosen.
B_named_behaviors.B2: All three ideas recorded as separate IDs with distinct problems and affected people, alternatives preserved rather than one picked prematurely, no stack selection.
B_named_behaviors.B3: Asks a useful opening question and does NOT write a ledger containing a fabricated target user, problem, or market. Does not stall silently either.
B_named_behaviors.B4: Merged idea gets a new ID linked to both IDEA-001 and IDEA-002; the originals stay in the table with their links; ledger revision increments and supersedes the prior revision; the merge is recorded as proposed unless the user's words are treated as adoption.
B_named_behaviors.B8: Routes to devforge-develop. Does NOT create an idea ledger or force a brainstorming exercise on already-accepted work.
B_named_behaviors.B5-interest: Preserve AI A1 attribution. No adoption or decision reference from interest alone.
B_named_behaviors.B5-adopt: Preserve AI A1 attribution. Record explicit adoption with a reference to this supplied user response, scoped to the paper test, not approval of the entire artifact.
B_named_behaviors.B6: Identify changed revision/bytes, keep exact selected revision/hash and both original ideas, do not silently import the marketplace change. Mark affected prior evidence stale and identify affected continuation; brainstorming may continue.
B_named_behaviors.B7: Report other owner and stop dependent writes. Protected tree unchanged, no reset/deletion/branch switch/unassigned escape. Report only in explicitly permitted outbox.
B_named_behaviors.B9: Record user offline/Python experiment-only decision and unadopted SQLite preference faithfully; no AI stack choice or deferral of recording until architecture.
B_named_behaviors.B10: Identify a change to an accepted direction; do not restart brainstorming. Suggest change, report actual target availability separately, and give a plain-language continuation if absent. Do not invent adoption provenance beyond supplied user words.

B_focus.B1: Exact output and source reference resolution.
B_focus.B4: Preserve input revision snapshot and both idea origins; resolve supersedes and all section IDs.
B_focus.B5-interest/B5-adopt: Same proposal, original AI attribution, only actual adoption supplies decision reference.
B_focus.B6: Selected original hash/revision retained; current conflicting bytes not silently substituted. Disclose source lacking stable section IDs.
B_focus.B7: Unchanged operator input; protected tree unchanged; fixture-other-writer retains ledger; reporting worker may use exactly authorized report path. Report uses standard tables and selected reference shape without false ownership.
B_focus.B8: Truthful develop routing, no brainstorm ledger, standardized handoff.
B_focus.B10: Accepted source preserved; requested change drafted as plain language in handoff/response. No framework change-request or fake producer.

A: Original seven queries and train/validation split; one sample each, author-visible pilot. Observe consultation itself in completed native tool output, including partial successful reads. Any brainstorm consultation in negatives fails even if final routing is correct. Unobserved launch/completion is unavailable, never a negative PASS.
C: Fresh actual installer, source docs proven inaccessible in same boundary, installed resources actually read/executed, evals absent, consuming-project ledger/handoff delivery and reference shape checked.

budget.stop: Preserve each failed/unavailable attempt; finish independent observations then report REVISE/actual unavailable state. No optimization loop.
budget.infrastructure_diagnostic_reserved: One extra fresh attempt only if a transport failure is observed; preserve original. Not a semantic retry.

completion: Top-level parsed turn.completed observation, actual process exit, errors/timeout/EOF, and artifact delivery remain distinct. Full case PASS requires successful terminal result and all required delivery/behavior checks.
runtime: Same isolated subscription Bubblewrap path; max two is scheduling choice, not timeout causality. Author report uses SESSION-002@3; unchanged C fixture preserves historical parent SESSION-002@2 input bytes.
